fileChanges: JustTones/ContentView.swift — compose secondary destinations through a shared active-tone presentation, bind it only to host-confirmed state, and maintain warning/keyboard-safe placement.

JustTones/TonePlaybackHost.swift — expose only the presentation data needed to state the actual active tone, if current UI state cannot truthfully represent it; do not change renderer or session lifecycle behavior in this Sprint.
JustTones/Localizable.xcstrings — add localizable active-tone state, summary, and Stop labels.
JustTonesUITests/JustTonesUITests.swift and JustTonesTests/JustTonesTests.swift — add state/secondary-destination coverage and deterministic presentation assertions.
notes: This Sprint does not authorize audio-engine idle teardown, session deactivation policy, background-mode changes, or a fix for the reported device-heating defect; that needs a dedicated playback-safety issue or explicitly expanded scope.
scope: Introduce an iPhone-only reusable active-tone presentation for secondary sheets and navigation destinations. It appears only while the host reports Starting or Playing, displays the sounding pitch/frequency and textual actual state, and provides one immediately reachable text-labeled Stop action.

Adopt the presentation in the Profiles, Tuning systems, Settings, export, import-review, and hearing-safety destinations without obscuring destructive confirmations, safety warnings, keyboards, or destination-specific navigation. It must disappear only after stopped/unavailable host state is confirmed.

Keep the primary header as the sole passive playback presentation on the tone screen. The secondary bar is summary-and-Stop only: it must not expose pitch, timbre, output, profile, authoring, import, or export controls.

Localize new state, Stop, and active-tone strings; use locale-aware pitch/frequency values; ensure VoiceOver order is tone summary, state, Stop; announce meaningful state changes once; preserve full-size Stop access under Dynamic Type and high contrast.

Add focused host/UI coverage for bar visibility across Starting, Playing, Stop, unavailable, profile navigation, nested sheets, warnings, and Dynamic Type-compatible layout. Exercise JT-TEST-059 and the direct accessibility requirements linked to T-0039.
summary: Implement one truthful, persistent active-tone/Stop treatment for iPhone secondary destinations and qualify its VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, localization, warning-focus, and state-transition behavior without creating a second editable tone screen.
title: SP-029 iPhone playback continuity and accessibility plan
verificationCriteria: JT-TEST-059 demonstrates that navigation away from an active tone retains one concise active-tone summary and immediate Stop path, which disappears only after host-confirmed stopped/unavailable state.

Manual VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, localized-text, warning-focus, interruption, route, and physical-device inspection validates the full state/presentation contract without treating simulator success as listening or accessibility acceptance.
